data.candidate_status: proposed diagnostic extension of published LLWR/MGM; novelty unproven; no independent validation
data.data_roles: six treatment-years are examples, not model training or validation samples
limitations: No paired yield or full farm budget is reported in this source; do not join other sites to fabricate validation.
Table3 integer percentages reproduce MGM only approximately; rounding intervals are not sampling confidence intervals.
Printed Table2 component means do not fully reproduce printed LLWR widths; no silent correction or daily reclassification.
Unknown stage durations prevent calculation of whole-season time-weighted fraction.
Thickness weights do not represent stage-dependent root density; early seedling root zone is shallower.
Worst-stage operation prioritizes stage shortfall and is noise-sensitive; retain full stage/depth matrix.
No observed daily above/below breakdown available; do not infer drought versus waterlogging from score alone.
Does not include temperature, erosion, carbon stocks, N losses or biodiversity; not a comprehensive ecosystem index.
Daily means can hide short within-day stresses; serial observations are not independent replicates.
A high score does not imply higher yield, verified carbon cash or an optimal subsidy.
